subject.title: fix(network): recognize all IPv4 loopback hosts

question: Should `isCanonicalDottedDecimalIPv4` and `isLoopbackIpAddress` become permanent public `ssrf-runtime` plugin SDK exports for cross-plugin local-host classification?
rationale: The implementation is a sensible shared-policy route, but a new plugin SDK surface is a long-lived compatibility commitment that cannot be decided from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt the public policy helpers
options.body: Keep the two exported helpers as the supported plugin contract, then merge after real runtime proof confirms the expanded loopback range remains strict.

options.title: Constrain the API surface
options.body: Use a narrower existing SDK seam or a purpose-specific helper if maintainers do not want general IP predicates as permanent plugin API.

recommendation.title: Adopt the public policy helpers
recommendation.body: Keep the two exported helpers as the supported plugin contract, then merge after real runtime proof confirms the expanded loopback range remains strict.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related merged loopback-policy work and this broader follow-up, making them the strongest available routing candidate in the supplied history.
